vulnerablePath: components/WorkpackEditor.tsx buildDelimited exported single-document CSV cells through CSV quoting only.
components/WorkpackEditor.tsx buildDelimited exported whole-workpack CSV, downloaded TSV, and clipboard TSV cells without formula-prefix neutralization.
lib/reporting-downloads.ts had a separate CSV neutralization implementation, so editor and reports behavior could drift.
patchContract.attackerControlledInput: Editable or generated workpack/report text that a victim operator later downloads, imports, or pastes into formula-evaluating spreadsheet software.
patchContract.securityInvariant: Every spreadsheet-delimited CSV/TSV cell whose first significant character is =, +, -, @, tab, or carriage return must be emitted as inert spreadsheet text by prefixing an apostrophe before delimiter-specific quoting or cleanup.
legitimateBehaviorPreserved: CSV quoting for commas, quotes, CR, and LF is preserved.
TSV tab and newline cleanup semantics are preserved after neutralization.
Non-spreadsheet text, JSON, HTML, XLSX, HWP, HWPX, DOC, JPG, and TXT exports are outside this patch wave.

changes.strategy: Extract one shared delimited-cell encoder and route WorkpackEditor CSV/TSV plus Reports CSV through it.

baselineReproduction.method: Static source comparison against HEAD before product patch.
baselineReproduction.result: Pre-patch WorkpackEditor contained function escapeCell and delimiter-specific CSV quote / TSV cleanup without formula neutralization; current source routes cells through encodeSpreadsheetDelimitedCell.
